findings.explanation: Lean proves `HD ([] : List Bool) = ARB` by `rfl`. HOL4 specifies only `HD (h::t) = h`. Either Boolean value for the empty list satisfies that equation, independently of the value of `ARB`. The Lean branch also propagates this choice to `EL 0 []`.
findings.repair:
private opaque hdNil {α : Type u} [Nonempty α] : α := ARB

def HD {α : Type u} [Nonempty α] : List α → α
  | h :: _ => h
  | [] => hdNil
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Prelude.List

example : HD ([] : List Bool) = ARB := rfl
findings.hol4_check: !b:bool. ?f:bool list -> bool. (f [] = b) /\ (!h t. f (h::t) = h)
